agent_explanation: High-speed (~53 m/s) diagonal graze into thin (0.2 thick) wall: step 1 body is 0.023 above surface, step 2 it has translated ~0.63 in one dt and embeds 0.228 into wall. Impulse plus positional correction fails to de-penetrate within the step despite 22 substeps, leaving overlap above 0.15 limit. Slowing tangential velocity removes the failure.
